items.headline: Lakers Stay Perfect in LA Showdown, Hawks Set Franchise Record
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers improved to 2-0 with a 125-117 victory over the Clippers in a thrilling cross-town rivalry game, fueled by Austin Reaves' 28 points and 9 assists. Meanwhile, the Atlanta Hawks secured a historic 128-81 blowout win against the Charlotte Hornets, marking the largest margin of victory in franchise history.

items.headline: Deni Avdija Leads Blazers Comeback; Sabonis Records Triple-Double in Loss
items.summary: Deni Avdija's 26 points, 6 rebounds, and 6 assists propelled the Portland Trail Blazers to a 128-120 comeback win over the Sacramento Kings, overcoming a 12-point deficit. Despite the loss, Kings center Domantas Sabonis delivered a dominant performance with 27 points, 19 rebounds, and 10 assists, recording his 69th career triple-double. Rookie Darius Acuff Jr. also shined for Sacramento with 33 points.
